en: Vintage sepia-toned image showing a small European town in a valley. On the left, partly hidden by trees, is a round stone tower-like building with a conical roof, likely part of a castle or fortification on a hill. On the right, across a sloping landscape with a path and low wall, stands a church with a tall spire surrounded by traditional houses. The caption "Dohna." appears in red at the bottom left.
